subject: Instrument ownership and slice-level economics workshop
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Cho <tim.cho@acmeapps.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Instrument ownership and slice-level economics workshop

Hi team,

Quick context: Acme has been digging into unexpected per-route cost spikes (mostly mid-length chat flows) and has asked for a clearer owner map plus a playbook we can hand to customer SREs. Sales and CS are pushing for a concise deliverable we can reuse for other large tenants.

Ask: can we run a 90-minute cross-functional workshop next week to:
- agree on "instrumentation ownership" for route slices (who owns telemetry, who owns billing reconciliation)
- define the minimum telemetry set (latency histogram, token-pathway tagging, cache hit rate)
- produce an owner-runbook template and a slice-cost calculation example

I attached a rough instrumentation checklist and a blank ownership template to speed things up. If you have telemetry gaps you already know about, flag them in your replies so we can prioritize.

Proposed attendees: Observability (Ben), Runtime Metrics (Dylan), Product Ops (Laura), Customer (Tim), plus me to capture action items.

Pls reply with availability and any must-have agenda items.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Attachments: instrumentation-checklist.md, slice-ownership-template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrument ownership and slice-level economics workshop

Thanks Jasmine — happy to join. A couple quick notes before we workshop:

- We currently don't have a reliable metric for KV cache collision rates per-tenant; that will make precise slice-level cost math noisy.
- Our top needs from Product: a prioritized list of the routes (by customer impact) so we can focus instrumentation sampling on high-cost flows.
- If we include sample traces/logs from Acme (Tim), that will help validate the token-pathway mapping.

I'll attach a short PDF with telemetry gaps I keep meaning to raise. Can we make one explicit action item "owner assigned for KV visibility"? Otherwise we'll surface this in the follow-up.

On calendar: I'm free Tue/Wed mornings PT next week.

Ben
Ben Carter
Product Observability Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: telemetry-gap-notes.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrument ownership and slice-level economics workshop

+1 from me. Proposed lightweight agenda to keep the workshop actionable:
1) 10m - Goals & success criteria (what does "done" look like for Acme)
2) 20m - Current telemetry review (Ben) - highlights and gaps
3) 25m - Ownership map walkthrough & decisions (who takes which slice)
4) 20m - Worked example: compute slice-level cost for one chat route (Dylan + Jasmine)
5) 15m - Action items + owners + timeline

Operational asks: please bring a sample of token-pathway traces (ideally 5 anonymized examples) and the route definition for Acme's most expensive flow. If Billing needs to be at the table for reconciliation rules, we should invite them; Laura can you confirm Billing rep?

I put a note to bake in a pre-flight script that will run a 24h sample and output per-route token counts so the worked example isn't based on hypotheticals.

Availability: Tue 10-12 PT works.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Runtime Metrics Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — I scheduled the 90-minute session for Tue, 9 May 2028 at 10:00 AM PT. Meeting link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/rdw-instrumentation-workshop

Agenda (first pass) attached. Quick action items before the workshop:
- Tim (Acme): please share 3 anonymized traces and the route config for the high-cost flow.
- Ben: highlight the top telemetry gaps in the agenda doc (we'll prioritize KV visibility).
- Dylan: drop the pre-flight script + instructions in the shared drive so Acme can run it ahead of time if they choose.
- Jasmine: collect route priority list from Sales + CS and add to the agenda.

I'll invite a Billing analyst (Priya) to the meeting for the reconciliation piece. If any critical attendees are missing, flag now.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
